hunters in their territory.

These spiked bracelets not
only look good, but make for
good exercise equipment!

as a weapon. Makes for a great
meal after a day of hunting.

weapons.name: F Alastor
weapons.desc:
A legendary sword brimming
with power. The bearer can even
survive being impaled.

weapons.name: F Rushing Hammer
weapons.desc:
The trusty hammer of a
heroic Palico who saved
the world.

weapons.name: F Melodic Baton
weapons.desc:
A baton that causes one to
weep uncontrollably when its
sounds reach the ear.

weapons.name: F Fan Megaphone
weapons.desc:
A Felyne-sized megaphone
that lets Palicoes cheer
you on during the hunt.

weapons.name: F Tenderpaw Clog
weapons.desc:
A heavy-duty fan club weapon
for attacking and getting
seriously pumped up.

weapons.name: F Giaprey Bayonet
weapons.desc:
A bayonet for Gunner-wannabes.

sword part that it can't fire.

weapons.name: F Conga Cymbals

These colorful, charming
weapons tinkle joyously
when used to attack.

weapons.name: F Barroth Mace
weapons.desc:
Made of a particularly
tough Barroth part, this
weapon can smash boulders.

weapons.name: F Second Sight Lens
weapons.desc:
Perfect for wannabe scouts,
this baby makes both recon
and hunting a piece of cake!

weapons.name: F Basarios Axe
weapons.desc:
The pawprint on this axe is
proof that a Palico's loyalty
is stronger than stone.

weapons.name: F Nerscylla Wedge

of Nerscylla, and so sharp, it

tusk that can freeze
prey at a blow.

eruptive volcano. Marvel at

meteor to lightly sever

bone is used in the head.

weapons.name: F Vprey Wedge X

a small, non-native monster.

serious muscle to wield.

weapons.name: F Gourmet Cheese X

made from fragrant cheese by
the Gourmew Chef.

weapons.name: F Moofah Cotton X

enough Moofah cotton to knit

weapons.name: F Deluxe BBQ

uncooked meat. Sadly, it's
been rendered inedible.

weapons.name: F Fish Stick X

weapon made of stone. More
useful than it looks.

weapons.name: F Smorgasbord

bird. Perfect for "drumming
up" help from your Palicoes.

weapons.name: F Bushwhacker X

weapons.name: F Paw Punch X

favored by Felynes. Sturdy
wood is used in the head.

weapons.name: F Bone Hammer X

to-find bones.

weapons.name: F Alta Net X

for offense. Insects fear
the sight of it.

weapons.name: F Bnaha Dagger X

resembling a feather. Sharp
enough to cut the wind.

weapons.name: F Jaggi Knife X

common Great Jaggi Scraps.
Weak, but a cinch to use.

weapons.name: F Rheno Hammer X

metal to Rhenoplos Scraps.
Wieldier than it looks.

weapons.name: F Slagtoth Leaf X

this weapon allow it to release

weapons.name: F Maccao Dagger X

sword part that it can't fire.

Break out this brush!

weapons.name: F Kut-Ku Cutter X

A grand sword made of Yian
Kut-Ku Scraps. (No, it's not
a fan... Stop asking.)

weapons.name: F Gypceros Glare X

resurrection. Its mystic
power makes fish fresh again.

weapons.name: F Cabra Pounder X

cut anything. Used for wood

Mushrooms. One wrong move

hit count and adds piercing.

of slashing claw attacks.

position.

ability to stun monsters.

treasure and other goodies.

a Palico to enter Beast Mode.
